purpose: Independent JANUS algorithm search over archive spectra outside the 12-group replay; not guaranteed previously unpublished observations.
selection: Metadata only, first two targets with complete Parkes fine S/R/S cadence; prefer MJD >= 58575, then earliest chronological cadence; if older, label archival reanalysis. Fine HDF5 files with matching frequency coverage; never inspect intensities to select.
drift_grid: integer total channel displacement across full scan
claims: All scores descriptive and post-search maxima; no discovery without independent follow-up, calibrated sensitivity and RFI exclusion.
